question: Should Control UI assistant-message copy expose a per-click Markdown/plain-text menu, add a persisted default copy-format preference, or decline this extra copy format for now?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the permanent UX shape and Markdown-to-plain-text semantics are product choices rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Add per-click copy-format menu
options.body: Keep the existing Markdown copy behavior and add a small menu with Markdown and plain-text choices without introducing persisted settings.

options.title: Add persisted copy-format preference
options.body: Let users choose a default copy format, accepting the extra preference, i18n, and settings-state surface.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Leave the current Markdown-only copy action and close the request if maintainers do not want extra Control UI copy-format surface.

recommendation.title: Add per-click copy-format menu
recommendation.body: Keep the existing Markdown copy behavior and add a small menu with Markdown and plain-text choices without introducing persisted settings.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current copy-as-markdown action and has the strongest history signal for this Control UI product decision.
